wages.text: McKinnor authored AB 288 to protect private-sector workers' right to unionize and previously led the effort to let legislative staff join a union.
wages.quote: if this federal government won't respect a worker's right to join a union

tax.text: Lockwood's campaign platform calls for reducing taxes and regulation on families.
tax.quote: Families will continue to be unburdened with the removal of restrictive taxes & red tape, the unleashing of California's abundant energy resources, and the upgrading of our infrastructure beyond previous empty promises.

safety.text: His platform leads with backing police and ending crime on the streets.
safety.quote: It begins with a renewed support for law enforcement. No more homelessness, drugs, and violent crime on our streets

energy.text: He calls for expanding California's energy production.
energy.quote: Families will continue to be unburdened with the removal of restrictive taxes & red tape, the unleashing of California's abundant energy resources, and the upgrading of our infrastructure beyond previous empty promises.
